description: This is a 3D model of a simple, modern desk with a single drawer unit on the right side. The desk has a rectangular, flat tabletop supported by four sturdy legs. The drawer unit is integrated seamlessly under the right side of the tabletop, featuring a single drawer with a metallic handle. The overall design is minimalist and functional, suitable for a home office or study space. The color is a uniform warm brown, giving it a natural and understated appearance. The shadow cast by the desk suggests it's placed on a light-colored floor under a light source from the left.
